Provenance of the NFCom test files in this folder

Source: akretion/nfelib (https://github.com/akretion/nfelib, MIT License, commit 7082879710d1400db31e0baa435a0506355e940f)

nfcom.xml
  Derived from: nfelib/nfcom/samples/v1_0/NFCom-nfcom.xml
  Changes:
  - anonymised: CNPJ 06117473000150 -> 99999999000191; emitter/recipient names, trade name, street,
    district, municipality, cMun/cMunFG, CEP, IE, phone, e-mail and gRespTec contact replaced by obvious test values
  - recomputed access key (mod 11 cDV) and Id from the ide/emit fields; qrCodNFCom rebuilt with the new key
  - tabs replaced by 2-space indentation
- appended a dummy, structurally valid ICP-Brasil xmldsig <Signature> (fixed c14n/rsa-sha1/sha1 algorithm URIs, Reference URI="#<Id>", dummy base64 DigestValue/SignatureValue/X509Certificate; no real certificate)

nfcom-proc.xml
  Built from nfcom.xml wrapped into <nfcomProc versao="1.00"> plus a synthetic <protNFCom versao="1.00">
- protocol (infProt) is synthetic: tpAmb 2, verAplic SVRS-TESTE-1.0, dummy nProt/digVal, cStat 100, xMotivo "Autorizado o uso da NFCom"
